Question ID: MAR_U03_PT_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.ECO.01

Unit pretest item 1. This question uses only Unit 3 mapped content.
Lesson focus: Marine Life Distribution and Ocean Conditions
Stimulus: Distribution map/table

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the habitat or organism. Then use the required stimulus (Distribution map/table) to connect the visible evidence to marine habitats, organisms, biodiversity, adaptation, and ecosystem change. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.ECO.01 and avoids this common mistake: naming an organism or habitat without explaining the evidence that supports survival, distribution, or change.
